modal.desc: 2nd place at the U-19 State Level Rapid Chess championship (2025) and 10th in Under-18 Boys at the UICC Trophy (2024). Chess is where the analytical habit was built — probabilistic thinking, pattern recognition and calm decisions under time pressure.

Won Best Research & Project across competing schools.
